prompt:
Create a multi-page React artifact that demonstrates state management, routing, and usage of multiple shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS.

Requirements:
- Use React 18 + TypeScript + Vite configured with the artifacts-builder stack.
- Implement at least three routes using React Router or similar: Home, Profile, and Settings.
- On the Home page, display a shadcn/ui Card component with a dynamic list of items stored in React state (at least 3 items).
- Provide a shadcn/ui Button to add a new item to the list dynamically.
- On the Profile page, create a controlled form using shadcn/ui Input and Label components, integrating react-hook-form with validation using zod.
- The form should include fields: username (required, min 3 chars), email (required, valid email).
- On the Settings page, show an Accordion component with at least two collapsible sections containing sample text.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling but avoid any centered layouts, purple gradients, uniform rounded corners, or Inter font.
- The project must have an index.html file in the root.
- After development, run "bash scripts/bundle-artifact.sh" to produce a single bundled artifact file called bundle.html in the root.
- Provide the complete source files necessary to run this project, including src/App.tsx with all components and routing.

Name your React project directory "multi-route-artifact" and ensure the final bundled artifact is exactly named "bundle.html" with all assets inlined, ready to share as a claude.ai HTML artifact.

Output the complete project in code files ready to build and bundle as specified.
